Our research lab has been holding daily team meetings and we keep losing track of what was discussed. I've been told there's a memory management tool already installed in the `memory-manager/` folder of the workspace that can help us log structured session records and then consolidate them into a single daily digest report.

Please use it to:
1. Log at least 3 separate research discussion sessions from today. Each session should capture realistic content from our lab's recent work on protein folding, CRISPR delivery, and HPC pipeline setup — include topics discussed, key findings, pending action items, decisions made, and the team's overall mood.
2. After logging all sessions, run the daily consolidation process to merge everything into a single dated report.

The consolidated report should end up wherever the tool naturally stores its daily summaries. Make sure the temporary session files are properly cleaned up afterward as the tool is designed to do.
